avis.titre: Disappointed in new formula of the Vitamin C "serum"
avis.texte: Ugh, these companies always fixing things that aren't broken. As a long-time loyal customer of ButtahSkin, I'm extremely disappointed by the recent change to the Vitamin C Serum formula. The previous version was far superior—thicker in texture, more effective on my skin, and provided a truly luxurious experience. Unfortunately, this new formula is a major letdown. Its watery consistency, almost like the Rosewater Toner, is nothing like the serum I once loved. This is not what I would expect from a high-quality product. To make matters worse, it no longer gives my skin that radiant glow it once did. I used to notice an instant brightness after using the old formula, but now my skin feels dull and lackluster.
